Built **Snackbound**, a complete sunny platform game in `index.html`. Help Mina, an adult beach explorer with long dark hair, collect treats across floating islands and reach the picnic flag. Each treat makes her tummy grow and raises her “snack-powered” size level.

- **Controls:** ←/→ or A/D to move, Space/↑/W to jump, R to restart
- **Mobile:** on-screen movement and jump buttons
- Includes a scrolling level, treat counter, size meter, sound toggle, and win/try-again screens.

I kept the character’s beach outfit modest and made the growth a playful power-up. Verified the JavaScript syntax and checked gameplay in-browser.
